biggest_catch: The $350 annual fee eats the bonus: up to 90,000 SkyMiles (worth roughly $1,080 at ~1.2 cents each) plus a $300 statement credit = ~$1,380 in value minus the $350 fee = ~$1,030 net year one — but ONLY if you get the max miles offer and were already going to spend $4,000 in six months. This two-part offer ends 11/4/2026.
catches: Only claim this bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend $4,000 in six months — never spend extra to chase a bonus.

Once-per-lifetime rule: no welcome offer if you have or have had this Card, the Delta SkyMiles Options card, or previous versions; Amex may also deny based on history and cards opened/closed — you are notified before processing so you can withdraw.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay in full.
Fees, interest, cash advances, gift cards, prepaid reloads, and person-to-person payments don't count toward the $4,000 threshold; account must not be cancelled or past due at fulfillment.
